note: The routing layer laid over the evacuation map (data/<F>_evac/), without changing it: which part of each floor is Primary, Secondary or Shared, where through-traffic is barred (gates) or discouraged (tolls), and what stairs, lifts and bridges cost. Read by tools/routing/build.mjs. An area marked "guess": true is a draft for the owner to confirm (none since 5 Nov 2026, when the owner answered the last of them on the review page). Coordinates are each floor's own sheet pixels.

shared.note: special areas both use: no section rule ever applies

sectionRule: A trip avoids the other section when at least one end is in a section: Secondary to Secondary, or Secondary to Shared, avoids Primary floor, and the reverse. Primary to Secondary, and Shared to Shared, avoid nothing. Avoided floor is a toll (rules.sectionAvoid), never a wall, so a room reachable only through the other section is still reached, by the least of it.

wingSections._why: Owner, 30 Oct 2026: Secondary is KB L3-L5, TK L4-L5, BT L4-L5, LKS L3 (the Secondary Arts Centre and Secondary Library) and sometimes a few LKS L2 music rooms; nothing in Toh Tuck except sometimes the Black Box Theatre. Classroom wings not named are Primary. L1's KB and LKS rooms are facilities and administration, L4's LKS rooms are school leadership, and L6 is the STEAM Centre: Shared until 5 Nov 2026, when the owner made it Secondary ("PE shared, steam and fitness secondary"). Floor is painted by the nearest room door of a wing, then the areas below override.

roomSections._why: Destinations whose section differs from their wing's, or that carry no wing code. A trip's section comes from its two ends. Owner, 5 Nov 2026 (review page): the play area and its sand pit are Shared; L5's Fitness Centre is Secondary (TK-406 and TK-422, the PE offices, stay Shared).

label.en: Pod G and the linkway deck

areas.why: Owner, 5 Nov 2026 (review page, the Black Box question): Pod G is Shared, so a trip to the Black Box Theatre is not charged for the way to its foyer. The floor between the gym's south wall (sheet y 500) and the foyer box (y 700): the linkway deck as far as this sheet draws it, Pod G, the activity pod in front of the gym, and the main lift lobby with Stairs 20's door. Before, a Secondary trip from the L4 bridge paid x5 a metre on 46 of its 69 m here, and 73 step-free trips to the theatre went round by another bridge and the Toh Tuck lift (L4 TK-407: 347 s; now 108 s over the L4 bridge); the stair trips were already the owner's, over the L4 gym bridge, and are unchanged. Tried and left out, 5 Nov: the same on TT_L2 and TT_L3 (deck, Pod G, lift lobby) sent the stair trips from L3 over the L3 bridge and up Stairs 20, 17 s longer, because the gym toll prices the L4 bridge's recess at x10, and sent 22 step-free trips from L4's KB rooms down to L3 and round (about 340 s against 120); the ground floor's way from the covered walkway to the main lift and Stairs 20, Shared without those, sent step-free trips from L3 down to L1 and across (about 350 s against 210). No trip that starts on the ground floor pays there anyway: L1 is all Shared, so its trips avoid nothing.

notGated._why: Named by the owner as no through traffic, but the map models them as closed rooms: a route can reach their doors and can never pass through them, so no gate is needed.

rules._why: Each metre of avoided-section floor is priced as 1.5 in Lakeside, and as 5 in the Toh Tuck wing (owner: nothing there for Secondary except the Black Box Theatre, reached over the L4 bridge). Tested on the sample trips (tools/routing/samples.json): KB-305 to BT-508 keeps the owner's route at any strength; at 2 or more, BT-414 to the L4 Roof Garden went down three floors to L1 and back up rather than walk 88 m of Primary corridor on L3; the Black Box trip needs Toh Tuck strong to use the L4 bridge. Tolls multiply the same way; a gate area's toll applies when it is open. Prices choose the route only: the distance and time shown are always real.

travel._walk: Routes keep off walls: floor closer than comfortMetres to a wall costs up to (1 + wallPenalty) per metre, falling to 1 at comfortMetres, so a corridor is walked down its middle and an open space is crossed straight. walkSpeed (m/s) turns metres into time.
travel._stairs: Per metre of rise: a 4 m storey is 20 s up (about 25 m of corridor) and 12 s down (about 15 m). Counted in the time shown: climbing takes that long.
travel._lifts: A lift is mostly the wait. Only a step-free trip takes a lift (owner, 5 Nov 2026: "just step free"); a step-free trip uses only lifts and ramps.
travel._landing: A stair landing printed on two sheets at one level (Stairs 12 at L1 and TT_L1) is the same spot: a couple of seconds, no flight.

BRIDGE-4.source: 39.6 m door to door, less the 34.2 m TT_L4 routes

Before 31 Oct 2026 these were the rise x 25 (40.6 / 33.8 / 41.9 m) on top of the deck Toh Tuck already routes, so bridge trips were about 30 m too long (scratchpad inv/bridges finding 1).
